3068070.baseName: Habitat Pack of 4 Christmas Candy Canes Path Finder Lights
3068070.variantName: Habitat Pack of 4 Christmas Candy Canes Path Finder Lights
3068070.sourceDescription: Welcome Christmas guests with this pack of 4 candy cane path finder lights. They're mains powered with 40 LED bulbs included, bringing that festive glow to pathways, driveways or borders from the moment they arrive. Each light comes with a base stake so you can pop them straight into the ground, tubs or pots wherever you need a cheerful festive marker. The built-in timer feature means they'll switch on and off automatically, saving you the daily trek outside. With a 5m lead from plug to decoration, you've got flexibility on placement without wrestling extension cables. They're suitable for both indoor and outdoor use, fully assembled and ready to light up your space straight from the box. . Size H60, W90, D2.5cm.; Suitable for indoor and outdoor use.; Timer feature.; Requires 40 x LED bulbs (included).; Mains powered.; 5m lead length between plug and decoration.; Fully assembled.; Not suitable for those under 16 years.; Made from plastic.; Manufacturer's 1 year guarantee.

yk11eba9.variantName: Pelle & Sol 6ft Snow-Tipped Christmas Tree with Metal Stand
yk11eba9.sourceDescription: Create a festive winter display with the Pelle & Sol Snow-Tipped Christmas Tree. Standing approximately 6ft (183cm) tall, this artificial tree features 700 branch tips with a flocked snowy finish for a full, seasonal appearance. Approximate dimensions are 100 x 28 x 30cm. The dense branches provide plenty of space for adding lights, baubles, ribbons and other Christmas decorations. A sturdy metal stand is included to help keep the tree securely positioned throughout the festive season. SNOW-TIPPED DESIGN: Flocked branches create a snowy winter-inspired finish for traditional and contemporary Christmas displays. METAL STAND INCLUDED: Supplied with a sturdy metal stand to support the tree during use. READY TO DECORATE: Suitable for adding your own lights, baubles, ribbons and other festive ornaments. REUSABLE ARTIFICIAL TREE: Designed to be dismantled and stored for use again during future Christmas seasons. Read the instructions before use Dreibach LTD, Unit 2 Capital Business Park, Manaor Way, WD6 1GW, United Kingdom.

apk3y0mq.baseName: Walplus 150 LED Fairy Lights Hinged Artificial Christmas Tree - Green - 150 cm
apk3y0mq.variantName: Walplus 150 LED Fairy Lights Hinged Artificial Christmas Tree - Green - 150 cm
apk3y0mq.sourceDescription: This modern Christmas tree decoration features a unique cone-shaped design, ideal for enhancing the festive atmosphere in any room or outdoor space. Crafted with PVC and PE materials, this piece offers a fade-resistant surface that ensures lasting appeal throughout the season. Premium Materials: Constructed from quality PVC and PE, this decorative item offers a fade-resistant exterior that withstands the test of time, maintaining its vibrant appearance throughout continuous use. Inclusive LED Lighting: Equipped with warm white LED decorative string lights that bring an elegant sparkle to your space. The warm glow offers a cozy, inviting ambiance that transforms any setting into a festive retreat. USB Connectivity: This decoration is powered via USB, offering flexible placement options. Whether it’s next to your indoor sleigh setup or enhancing your garden terrace, it seamlessly plugs into various devices for a hassle-free experience. Modern Aesthetic: With its sleek cone-shaped form and minimalist style, this decoration embodies modern decor principles. It harmonizes with both traditional and contemporary holiday displays. Simple Assembly: Requires assembly by two people, according to the manufacturer’s instructions, ensuring that every piece fits together perfectly and functions as intended. Product Specifications Colour: Green Material: PE and PVC Tree height: 150 cm Bottom diameter: 68 cm Stand size: 35 cm Durable Lifelike tips Hinged Construction for Set up Foldable Stand Number of PE tips: 77 Number of PVC tips: 303 Number of needle tips: 76 Number of pine cones: 40 Number of red berries: 40 Lights type: Decorative string lights Lights color: Warm white Lights length: 1500 cm Number of LEDs: 150 Distance between LEDs: 10 cm LED flash modes: 8 Power source: USB Batteries Included: No Voltage: 5 V Indoor and sheltered outdoor use Assembly required: Yes Delivery-contains: 1 x Christmas tree 1 x Foldable Stand 1 x LED string light This product is powered by DC 5V, but the certified 5V USB power source is not included. Higher voltage may cause overheating to occur and may result in damage to the device and the potential risk of overheating and fiire. • By choosing FSC certified products, you are supporting responsible management of the world's forests. This artificial tree is intended exclusively for indoor festive decoration. Assemble the product on a flat, stable surface using the provided stand to prevent tipping, which could cause injury or property damage. Keep this item away from open flames, candles, fireplaces, and space heaters, as synthetic materials can melt or catch fire under extreme heat. If using electric lights, ensure they are safety-certified and do not leave them turned on unattended. This product is not a toy; keep small parts, detachable ornaments, and packaging away from young children and pets to prevent choking or suffocation. Store in a cool, dry place when not in use to ensure long-term structural safety. WALPLUS, Unit 124, Anglesey Business Park, Littleworth Road, Hednesford, WS12 1NR, United Kingd
